1.title: US hits three Iranian oil tankers after saying its warships were targeted
1.summary: The tit-for-tat strikes come nearly a week after fighting between the US and Iran flared again following weeks of relative calm.

2.title: Is Work Starting for Trump’s Arch? It Depends Who’s Asking.
2.summary: The Justice Department told a court the government would only conduct archaeological excavation, a day after a Trump official announced the project was in motion.

3.title: Missouri Asks Supreme Court to Allow Voting Map Benefiting Republicans
3.summary: Missouri’s Supreme Court said a map redrawn to help Republicans could not be used in November and said voters should decide on the new boundaries.

4.title: US envoys in Moscow ahead of Ukraine talks
4.summary: President Trump says his envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are "bringing with them a proposal to end the war".
